execution: decide at close, fill at next open, long-only, no leverage
hypothesis: Altcoins may react to a BTC impulse a few minutes late. The literature puts the lag at seconds to minutes with a disputed direction, so the expectation is that nothing is left after 20 bps round trip. The test shows whether anything survives inside 15 minutes behind a 5-minute BTC jump.
rules: 5m bars, log returns. sigma = standard deviation of the last 288 bar returns (including the closed bar), per asset.
Trigger for ETH or SOL at a bar close: BTC return >= 2.0 sigma_BTC AND the asset's own return in that bar < 0.5 sigma_asset.
Hold the asset for the next 3 bars (overlapping triggers extend the hold), weight 0.5 per asset; BTC itself is never held.
Decide at the bar close, fill at the next bar open, long-only, no leverage.
